integrity: Universal count, uniqueness, Hessian spectrum bounds, energy-gap and gradient moment follow from analytic local-sign and multilinearity arguments. Enumerations are finite transcription checks only.
scientific_limitations: An explicit diagonal, degree-three triangle-chain family with positive local fields and weak nonuniform bridges; not the identical graph or equal-magnitude disorder ensemble of the source experiments. Strict local minima only. No lower bound on optimizer runtime, basin volume, or noncommuting/entangling-ansatz behavior.
title: Exponential uniformly curved traps in a connected frustrated Ising VQE landscape
